verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming app. A buyer could fairly ask whether such a tool exposes a programmatic API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no public API, no API versioning and no deprecation policy, and probes for OpenAPI specs at the candidate paths and for llms.txt all returned 404. The command-line host runner and nightly builds are developer building blocks or release mechanics, not versioned APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
